description: This file is a shell script used for testing the integration and handling of metadata encoding in a Perforce to Git import process. It includes setup steps, test cases, and commands related to different text encodings (UTF-8, Latin-1, CP1252, CP850) to verify how the system manages inconsistent text encodings during import.

methods.name: remove_user_cache
methods.description: Removes the user cache file at ~/.gitp4-usercache.txt if it exists.
